import importlib.util,json,pathlib,platform,statistics,subprocess,sys,time
root=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]);seed=int(sys.argv[2]);out=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[3])
sys.path[:0]=[str(root/'src'),str(root/'tests')]
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('bench',root/'tools/bench_b0.py');b=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(b)
from torchoed import optimal_design
t=b.torch;t.set_num_threads(1)
pools=[(f'grid{k}',b.full_factorial([3]*k).double()-1) for k in (2,3,4)]
pools.append(('random500',2*t.rand(500,3,dtype=t.float64,generator=t.Generator().manual_seed(0))-1));rows=[]
for name,C in pools:
 F=b.polynomial_features(C,degree=2);p=F.shape[1]
 for n in [p,2*p]+([7] if name=='grid2' else []):
  for criterion in 'DAI':
   row=dict(pool=name,n=n,criterion=criterion,seed=seed,times_seconds=[])
   try:
    for repeat in range(3 if criterion=='D' else 1):
     begin=time.perf_counter();r=optimal_design(F,n,criterion=criterion,restarts=1,generator=t.Generator().manual_seed(seed));row['times_seconds'].append(time.perf_counter()-begin)
    row.update(median_seconds=statistics.median(row['times_seconds']),ids=r['ids'].tolist(),objective=r['objective'])
    if criterion=='D':row['d_efficiency_lower_bound']=r['d_efficiency_lower_bound']
   except ValueError as exc:row['error']=type(exc).__name__+': '+str(exc)
   rows.append(row);print(name,n,criterion,row.get('median_seconds',row.get('error')),flush=True)
   out.write_text(json.dumps(dict(source_sha=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=root,text=True).strip(),environment=dict(python=platform.python_version(),platform=platform.platform(),cpu=platform.processor(),torch=t.__version__,numpy=b.np.__version__,scipy=b.version('scipy'),pydoe=b.version('pydoe'),threads=1),rows=rows),allow_nan=False)+'\n')

import os,pathlib,subprocess
for key in ('OMP_NUM_THREADS','MKL_NUM_THREADS','OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS'):os.environ[key]='1'
r=pathlib.Path.cwd();s=r/'scratch';python=r.parent/'.sae-w95-venv/Scripts/python.exe'
for seed in range(5):
 for side,checkout in [('base',s/'base'),('head',r)]:
  label=f'{side}{seed}';print('START',label,flush=True)
  with (s/(label+'.log')).open('w') as log:subprocess.run([str(python),str(s/'worker.py'),str(checkout),str(seed),str(s/(label+'.json'))],stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True)
  print('DONE',label,flush=True)
